The '''Contruum militia''' was a planetary defense force made up of the natives of [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]]. It was organized in the wake of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] occupation by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and engaged the Imperial forces in [[Contruum rebellion|full-scale warfare]] that resulted in the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] withdrawing the Imperial forces.
